verdict.rationale: Bench is a software-plus-human bookkeeping service. An official CLI is a fair question for a SaaS product, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence mentions a CLI: the documented surfaces are an in-app experience, messaging, reports and downloads. Probes also found no llms.txt, markdown docs or OpenAPI spec.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
